summary: Backend-only U2-0/U2-a verification completed on /app/voom-repo with real local PostgreSQL15/PostgREST loopback lab and Deno/Node suites. Core suites PASS (U2 contract/bridge, local RLS verify, U1 232 checks), plus one new negative edge suite exposed 2 strict-response-validator defects.

critical.issue: validateTransportResponse accepts receipt.status='pending' with processingExpired=false and recoverable=false; this violates strict recovery semantics for non-expired pending requests.
validateTransportResponse accepts outcome='not_accepted' responses carrying acceptedAt/responseExpiresAt commit metadata; should be rejected for non-accepted requests.

action_items: In response-validation.ts consistency(), enforce pending receipt recoverable=true when processingExpired=false.
In response-validation.ts consistency(), reject acceptedAt/responseExpiresAt when outcome is not 'committed'.
After fix, rerun edge_receipt_negative.unit.ts + run_contract.sh to prevent strictness regressions.

rca of the issue:
RCA-1: response-validation.ts consistency() only forces recoverable=false for processingExpired/not_found/expired and done, but never enforces recoverable=true for pending non-expired receipts; thus invalid pending state slips through validator.
RCA-2: turn consistency only checks committed responses must include acceptedAt/responseExpiresAt, but lacks inverse check forbidding commit metadata on non-committed outcomes, allowing semantic leakage of acceptance metadata on not_accepted responses.
Repro: run deno script /app/voom-repo/tests/gptour-semantic/u2/edge_receipt_negative.unit.ts; both assertions fail with current code.
